title: Finding
description: One claim, at a stated confidence, bound to the evidence that earns it.

statement.description: The claim, written so that it is checkable. Prefer a number and an address over an adjective.

confidence.description: proven: read directly from chain state at a pinned block. strongly_supported: multiple independent sources agree, at least one of them onchain. inferred: reasoned from evidence, not read directly. unknown: not established. unavailable: could not be checked because of a coverage limitation.

impact.description: What this changes for a holder, in one sentence.

falsifier.description: The observation that would overturn this claim. Required above 'unknown'.

reasoning.description: Required for inferred findings: the step from evidence to claim.

why_unknown.description: Required for unknown and unavailable: what was attempted and what stopped it.

severity.description: Severity of the risk this finding describes, not a score for the asset.

counterpoint.description: The strongest argument against this finding's importance. Included so a reader sees both sides.
